# gitmoap_catalog_environment_deployments (Data Source)

What is deployed into an environment. The current deployment of every service in this environment, up to `limit` services (100 at most, 20 by default). A service declared in a group you cannot see is left out, so being able to read a shared environment does not reveal every service deployed into it. Reporters and above on the environment's owner may call it.

The token needs `catalog:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) The environment's id

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `commit_sha` (String)
- `deployed_at` (String)
- `deployment_id` (String)
- `environment_id` (String)
- `pipeline_run_id` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `service_id` (String)
- `status` (String) Where a deployment is in its life. It starts `requested`; waits as `awaiting_approval` when the
environment needs approval, ending `rejected` if refused; then `running`, ending `succeeded`,
`failed` or `cancelled`. `skipped` means another deploy held the environment and its policy is to
skip. A successful deployment becomes `superseded` when a later one replaces it.
